_comment: collection -> source spec. Reseed embeds (KR_EMBED_*) + recreates each Qdrant collection. Naming: code_<project-basename> by default, OR explicit project.yml::knowledge_collection override for twin/shared-repo projects (see setup-project.sh) — must match the value written to that project's .claude/config/knowledge.json.
_spec: { repo: path to ANY clone (it only supplies git objects), ref: the canonical revision that IS the index, dirs: repo-relative subdirs, repoName: name stored in the payload }. Paths are relative to this file. A bare array of dirs is the legacy form — still accepted, but it indexes a live working tree, so one developer's WIP leaks into a collection every checkout of that repo reads; the indexer warns about it.
_why_ref: juz-ide-api-1..4 are four checkouts of one repo sharing ONE collection. Indexing whichever tree happens to be on disk makes the index mean 'whatever api-1 was doing that afternoon'. Pinning to origin/develop makes it mean 'the merged trunk' — the one answer that is equally true in all four (TASK-RAG-004 R2). Reseed after a merge to develop, not on every file save.
